state_machine.meaning: Fill command is false; includes initial/reset, safety stop, high-level stop, inhibit, and middle-band retain-off.

transitions.guard: NOT SensorFault AND NOT Inhibit AND NOT HighWet AND NOT LowWet
otherwise, including LowWet AND NOT HighWet AND NOT Inhibit (middle band)

state_machine.meaning: Fill command is true; active refill unless stopped by safety/operational priority.

transitions.guard: NOT SensorFault AND NOT Inhibit AND NOT HighWet AND NOT LowWet
LowWet AND NOT HighWet AND NOT Inhibit
transitions.action: retain Fill := TRUE in middle band

transitions.guard: otherwise, with no stop condition and no low-dry start condition

reset_conditions: No timers are used; hysteresis is state-based, not time-based.
Instance reset clears FillState to STOPPED, Fill to FALSE, SensorFault to FALSE, and qFill to FALSE.

priorities: 1. Safety override: SensorFault = HighWet AND NOT LowWet is always derived and forces Fill = FALSE.
2. Safety/operational override: Inhibit = TRUE forces Fill = FALSE.
3. Safety override: HighWet = TRUE forces Fill = FALSE.
4. Start request: if not stopped and LowWet = FALSE, Fill = TRUE.
5. Hysteresis retain: in the middle band LowWet = TRUE AND HighWet = FALSE AND Inhibit = FALSE, retain previous Fill.
6. Initial/reset default: Fill = FALSE and SensorFault = FALSE before the first scan and after reset.

scan_execution_order.name: edge_sampling
actions: Sample LowWet, HighWet, and Inhibit exactly once into scan-local values.
Capture qFill from the previous observed O[k-1].Fill; at reset qFill = FALSE.
No edge flags are required for this task; sampled BOOL values are used directly.

scan_execution_order.name: safety_reset_priority_and_state_transitions
actions: Apply instance reset if present: FillState := STOPPED, Fill := FALSE, SensorFault := FALSE, qFill := FALSE.
Compute SensorFaultNext := HighWet AND NOT LowWet.
Evaluate stop priority first: if SensorFaultNext OR Inhibit OR HighWet, next state is STOPPED and Fill is forced FALSE.
Else evaluate start: if NOT LowWet AND NOT HighWet AND NOT Inhibit, next state is FILLING.
Else retain the current FillState for middle-band hysteresis.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional_timer_fb_calls_outside_case_if
actions: No timer function blocks are required.
Stage intentionally contains no CASE/IF-gated timer calls; it is a no-op for this task.

scan_execution_order.name: unified_output_assignments
actions: qFill := Fill, so qFill for the next scan equals the actual post-scan observed O[k].Fill.
